title: Scene Informer: Anchor-based Occlusion Inference and Trajectory Prediction in Partially Observable Environments
summary: Query only occluded regions that can intersect the planned route, while separating hidden-agent existence probability from its conditional future motion.

mechanisms.name: Scene Informer: Anchor-based Occlusion Inference and Trajectory Prediction in Partially Observable Environments — dtr:DR44 route mechanism
mechanisms.description: Query only occluded regions that can intersect the planned route, while separating hidden-agent existence probability from its conditional future motion.
mechanisms.limitations: Simulated occlusions on autonomous-driving representations; it cannot establish an unseen person from wearable RGB.
